results.question: Show annual revenue, total cost, gross profit, gross margin percentage, and total order lines by fiscal year. Return columns: Fiscal Year, total_revenue, total_cost, gross_profit, gross_margin_pct, total_order_lines. Sort by Fiscal Year ascending.
results.sql:
SELECT
  "d"."Fiscal Year" AS "Fiscal Year",
  SUM("s"."Sales Amount") AS total_revenue,
  SUM("s"."Total Product Cost") AS total_cost,
  SUM("s"."Sales Amount" - "s"."Total Product Cost") AS gross_profit,
  (SUM("s"."Sales Amount" - "s"."Total Product Cost") / SUM("s"."Sales Amount")) * 100 AS gross_margin_pct,
  COUNT("s"."SalesOrderLineKey") AS total_order_lines
FROM "Sales" AS "s"
JOIN "Date" AS "d"
  ON "s"."OrderDateKey" = "d"."DateKey"
GROUP BY "d"."Fiscal Year"
ORDER BY "d"."Fiscal Year" ASC;

results.question: Compare the Reseller and Internet sales channels showing total revenue, revenue share percentage, number of distinct sales orders, order lines, average line amount, and gross margin percentage. Return columns: Channel, total_revenue, revenue_share_pct, total_orders, order_lines, avg_line_amount, gross_margin_pct. Sort by total_revenue descending.
results.sql:
SELECT
  so."Channel",
  SUM(s."Sales Amount") AS total_revenue,
  SUM(s."Sales Amount") * 100.0 / SUM(SUM(s."Sales Amount")) OVER () AS revenue_share_pct,
  COUNT(DISTINCT so."Sales Order") AS total_orders,
  COUNT(*) AS order_lines,
  SUM(s."Sales Amount") / COUNT(*) AS avg_line_amount,
  (SUM(s."Sales Amount") - SUM(s."Total Product Cost")) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(s."Sales Amount"), 0) AS gross_margin_pct
FROM "Sales" AS s
JOIN "Sales_Order" AS so
  ON s."SalesOrderLineKey" = so."SalesOrderLineKey"
GROUP BY so."Channel"
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

results.question: Show revenue, revenue share percentage, units sold, gross profit, and gross margin percentage by product category. Return columns: Category, revenue, revenue_share_pct, units_sold, gross_profit, gross_margin_pct. Sort by revenue descending.
results.sql:
WITH category_sales AS (
  SELECT
    "Product"."Category" AS "Category",
    SUM("Sales"."Sales Amount") AS "revenue",
    SUM("Sales"."Order Quantity") AS "units_sold",
    SUM("Sales"."Sales Amount") - SUM("Sales"."Total Product Cost") AS "gross_profit"
  FROM "Sales"
  INNER JOIN "Product"
    ON "Sales"."ProductKey" = "Product"."ProductKey"
  GROUP BY "Product"."Category"
)
SELECT
  "Category",
  "revenue",
  ("revenue" * 100.0) / NULLIF(SUM("revenue") OVER (), 0) AS "revenue_share_pct",
  "units_sold",
  "gross_profit",
  ("gross_profit" * 100.0) / NULLIF("revenue", 0) AS "gross_margin_pct"
FROM category_sales
ORDER BY "revenue" DESC;

results.question: List the top 10 products by revenue, showing product name, category, subcategory, revenue, units sold, gross profit, and margin percentage. Return columns: Product, Category, Subcategory, revenue, units_sold, gross_profit, margin_pct. Sort by revenue descending, limit to 10 rows.
results.sql:
SELECT
  p."Product",
  p."Category",
  p."Subcategory",
  SUM(s."Sales Amount") AS revenue,
  SUM(s."Order Quantity") AS units_sold,
  SUM(s."Sales Amount") - SUM(s."Total Product Cost") AS gross_profit,
  ((SUM(s."Sales Amount") - SUM(s."Total Product Cost")) / NULLIF(SUM(s."Sales Amount"), 0)) * 100 AS margin_pct
FROM "Sales" s
JOIN "Product" p
  ON s."ProductKey" = p."ProductKey"
GROUP BY
  p."Product",
  p."Category",
  p."Subcategory"
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 10

results.question: Show revenue and units sold broken down by territory group, country, region, and fiscal year. Return columns: Group, Country, Region, Fiscal Year, revenue, units_sold. Sort by Group, Country, Region, then Fiscal Year all ascending.
results.sql:
SELECT
  "Sales_Territory"."Group" AS "Group",
  "Sales_Territory"."Country" AS "Country",
  "Sales_Territory"."Region" AS "Region",
  "Date"."Fiscal Year" AS "Fiscal Year",
  SUM("Sales"."Sales Amount") AS "revenue",
  SUM("Sales"."Order Quantity") AS "units_sold"
FROM "Sales"
JOIN "Sales_Territory"
  ON "Sales"."SalesTerritoryKey" = "Sales_Territory"."SalesTerritoryKey"
JOIN "Date"
  ON "Sales"."OrderDateKey" = "Date"."DateKey"
GROUP BY
  "Sales_Territory"."Group",
  "Sales_Territory"."Country",
  "Sales_Territory"."Region",
  "Date"."Fiscal Year"
ORDER BY
  "Sales_Territory"."Group" ASC,
  "Sales_Territory"."Country" ASC,
  "Sales_Territory"."Region" ASC,
  "Date"."Fiscal Year" ASC;

results.question: List the top 15 direct customers (excluding CustomerKey -1) by lifetime revenue, showing customer name, city, state/province, country/region, total orders, total line items, total units, lifetime revenue, and lifetime profit. Return columns: Customer, City, State-Province, Country-Region, total_orders, total_line_items, total_units, lifetime_revenue, lifetime_profit. Sort by lifetime_revenue descending, limit to 15 rows.
results.sql:
SELECT
  c."Customer",
  c."City",
  c."State-Province",
  c."Country-Region",
  COUNT(DISTINCT so."Sales Order") AS total_orders,
  COUNT(DISTINCT s."SalesOrderLineKey") AS total_line_items,
  SUM(s."Order Quantity") AS total_units,
  SUM(s."Sales Amount") AS lifetime_revenue,
  SUM(s."Sales Amount" - s."Total Product Cost") AS lifetime_profit
FROM "Sales" AS s
JOIN "Customer" AS c
  ON s."CustomerKey" = c."CustomerKey"
LEFT JOIN "Sales_Order" AS so
  ON s."SalesOrderLineKey" = so."SalesOrderLineKey"
WHERE s."CustomerKey" <> -1
GROUP BY
  c."Customer",
  c."City",
  c."State-Province",
  c."Country-Region"
ORDER BY lifetime_revenue DESC
LIMIT 15;

results.question: For the Reseller channel only, show reseller count, total revenue, revenue per reseller, gross profit, and margin percentage by business type. Return columns: Business Type, reseller_count, total_revenue, revenue_per_reseller, gross_profit, margin_pct. Sort by total_revenue descending.
results.sql:
SELECT
  "r"."Business Type" AS "Business Type",
  COUNT(DISTINCT "r"."ResellerKey") AS "reseller_count",
  SUM("s"."Sales Amount") AS "total_revenue",
  SUM("s"."Sales Amount") / COUNT(DISTINCT "r"."ResellerKey") AS "revenue_per_reseller",
  SUM("s"."Sales Amount" - "s"."Total Product Cost") AS "gross_profit",
  (SUM("s"."Sales Amount" - "s"."Total Product Cost") / SUM("s"."Sales Amount")) * 100 AS "margin_pct"
FROM "Sales" AS "s"
INNER JOIN "Sales_Order" AS "so"
  ON "s"."SalesOrderLineKey" = "so"."SalesOrderLineKey"
INNER JOIN "Reseller" AS "r"
  ON "s"."ResellerKey" = "r"."ResellerKey"
WHERE "so"."Channel" = 'Reseller'
GROUP BY "r"."Business Type"
ORDER BY "total_revenue" DESC;

results.question: Show monthly revenue, number of distinct sales orders, and units sold for each month. Return columns: Month, MonthKey, monthly_revenue, orders, units_sold. Sort by MonthKey ascending.
results.sql:
SELECT
  d."Month",
  d."MonthKey",
  SUM(s."Sales Amount") AS monthly_revenue,
  COUNT(DISTINCT so."Sales Order") AS orders,
  SUM(s."Order Quantity") AS units_sold
FROM "Sales" AS s
JOIN "Date" AS d
  ON s."OrderDateKey" = d."DateKey"
JOIN "Sales_Order" AS so
  ON s."SalesOrderLineKey" = so."SalesOrderLineKey"
GROUP BY
  d."Month",
  d."MonthKey"
ORDER BY
  d."MonthKey" ASC;

results.question: Show order lines, revenue, units sold, revenue per unit (total revenue ÷ total units sold), average list price per product in the subcategory, gross profit, and margin percentage for each product subcategory. Return columns: Subcategory, order_lines, revenue, units_sold, revenue_per_unit, avg_list_price, gross_profit, margin_pct. Sort by revenue descending.
results.sql:
WITH "product_avg" AS (
    SELECT
        "Subcategory",
        AVG("List Price") AS "avg_list_price"
    FROM "Product"
    GROUP BY "Subcategory"
),
"subcategory_sales" AS (
    SELECT
        "p"."Subcategory",
        COUNT(DISTINCT "s"."SalesOrderLineKey") AS "order_lines",
        SUM("s"."Sales Amount") AS "revenue",
        SUM("s"."Order Quantity") AS "units_sold",
        "pa"."avg_list_price",
        SUM("s"."Sales Amount" - "s"."Total Product Cost") AS "gross_profit"
    FROM "Sales" AS "s"
    JOIN "Product" AS "p"
        ON "s"."ProductKey" = "p"."ProductKey"
    JOIN "product_avg" AS "pa"
        ON "p"."Subcategory" = "pa"."Subcategory"
    GROUP BY
        "p"."Subcategory",
        "pa"."avg_list_price"
)
SELECT
    "Subcategory",
    "order_lines",
    "revenue",
    "units_sold",
    "revenue" / NULLIF("units_sold", 0) AS "revenue_per_unit",
    "avg_list_price",
    "gross_profit",
    "gross_profit" / NULLIF("revenue", 0) * 100 AS "margin_pct"
FROM "subcategory_sales"
ORDER BY "revenue" DESC;

results.question: Show year-over-year revenue growth by channel and product category, comparing consecutive fiscal years. Return columns: Channel, Category, prior_year, prior_revenue, current_year, current_revenue, yoy_growth_pct. Sort by Channel, Category, then prior_year all ascending.
results.sql:
WITH annual_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        so."Channel" AS "Channel",
        p."Category" AS "Category",
        d."Fiscal Year" AS "Fiscal Year",
        CAST(REGEXP_REPLACE(d."Fiscal Year", '[^0-9]', '', 'g') AS INTEGER) AS fiscal_year_num,
        SUM(s."Sales Amount") AS revenue
    FROM "Sales" AS s
    JOIN "Sales_Order" AS so
        ON s."SalesOrderLineKey" = so."SalesOrderLineKey"
    JOIN "Product" AS p
        ON s."ProductKey" = p."ProductKey"
    JOIN "Date" AS d
        ON s."OrderDateKey" = d."DateKey"
    GROUP BY
        so."Channel",
        p."Category",
        d."Fiscal Year",
        fiscal_year_num
),
yoy AS (
    SELECT
        "Channel",
        "Category",
        "Fiscal Year" AS current_year,
        revenue AS current_revenue,
        fiscal_year_num,
        LAG("Fiscal Year") OVER (
            PARTITION BY "Channel", "Category"
            ORDER BY fiscal_year_num
        ) AS prior_year,
        LAG(revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY "Channel", "Category"
            ORDER BY fiscal_year_num
        ) AS prior_revenue,
        LAG(fiscal_year_num) OVER (
            PARTITION BY "Channel", "Category"
            ORDER BY fiscal_year_num
        ) AS prior_fiscal_year_num
    FROM annual_revenue
)
SELECT
    "Channel",
    "Category",
    prior_year,
    prior_revenue,
    current_year,
    current_revenue,
    ROUND(((current_revenue - prior_revenue) / NULLIF(prior_revenue, 0)) * 100, 2) AS yoy_growth_pct
FROM yoy
WHERE prior_year IS NOT NULL
  AND fiscal_year_num = prior_fiscal_year_num + 1
ORDER BY
    "Channel" ASC,
    "Category" ASC,
    prior_year ASC;

results.question: Show the number of products, average list price, minimum list price, and maximum list price for each product category. Return columns: Category, product_count, avg_list_price, min_list_price, max_list_price. Sort by product_count descending.
results.sql: SELECT "Category", COUNT(*) AS product_count, AVG("List Price") AS avg_list_price, MIN("List Price") AS min_list_price, MAX("List Price") AS max_list_price FROM "Product" GROUP BY "Category" ORDER BY product_count DESC

results.question: Show the number of resellers, number of distinct business types, and number of distinct states/provinces for each country. Return columns: Country-Region, reseller_count, business_type_count, state_count. Sort by reseller_count descending.
results.sql:
SELECT
  "Country-Region",
  COUNT(*) AS reseller_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT "Business Type") AS business_type_count,
  COUNT(DISTINCT "State-Province") AS state_count
FROM "Reseller"
GROUP BY "Country-Region"
ORDER BY reseller_count DESC;

results.question: Show total revenue, units sold, revenue per unit (total revenue ÷ total units sold), average list price per product in the category, realized discount percentage versus that average list price, gross profit, and margin percentage by sales channel and product category. Return columns: Channel, Category, total_revenue, units_sold, revenue_per_unit, avg_list_price, realized_discount_pct, gross_profit, margin_pct. Sort by Channel ascending, then total_revenue descending.
results.sql:
WITH product_category AS (
  SELECT
    "Category",
    AVG("List Price") AS avg_list_price
  FROM "Product"
  GROUP BY "Category"
),
sales_by_channel_category AS (
  SELECT
    so."Channel",
    p."Category",
    SUM(s."Sales Amount") AS total_revenue,
    SUM(s."Order Quantity") AS units_sold,
    SUM(s."Sales Amount" - s."Total Product Cost") AS gross_profit
  FROM "Sales" AS s
  JOIN "Sales_Order" AS so
    ON s."SalesOrderLineKey" = so."SalesOrderLineKey"
  JOIN "Product" AS p
    ON s."ProductKey" = p."ProductKey"
  GROUP BY
    so."Channel",
    p."Category"
)
SELECT
  sbcc."Channel",
  sbcc."Category",
  sbcc.total_revenue,
  sbcc.units_sold,
  sbcc.total_revenue / NULLIF(sbcc.units_sold, 0) AS revenue_per_unit,
  pc.avg_list_price,
  1 - (sbcc.total_revenue / NULLIF(sbcc.units_sold, 0)) / NULLIF(pc.avg_list_price, 0) AS realized_discount_pct,
  sbcc.gross_profit,
  sbcc.gross_profit / NULLIF(sbcc.total_revenue, 0) AS margin_pct
FROM sales_by_channel_category AS sbcc
JOIN product_category AS pc
  ON sbcc."Category" = pc."Category"
ORDER BY
  sbcc."Channel" ASC,
  sbcc.total_revenue DESC;

results.question: Show quarter-over-quarter revenue growth by channel and product category, comparing consecutive fiscal quarters. Return columns: Channel, Category, prior_quarter, prior_revenue, current_quarter, current_revenue, qoq_growth_pct. Sort by Channel, Category, then prior_quarter all ascending.

For each product category, list the top 2 subcategories by revenue, showing revenue rank within the category, revenue, units sold, gross profit, and revenue share percentage within the category. Return columns: Category, revenue_rank, Subcategory, revenue, units_sold, gross_profit, category_revenue_share_pct. Sort by Category, revenue_rank, then Subcategory all ascending.

Within each sales channel, show revenue, revenue share percentage, cumulative revenue share percentage ordered by revenue descending, number of distinct sales orders, and gross profit by product category. Return columns: Channel, Category, revenue, channel_revenue_share_pct, cumulative_channel_revenue_share_pct, orders, gross_profit. Sort by Channel ascending, then revenue descending, then Category ascending.
results.sql:
WITH "category_sales" AS (
  SELECT
    "so"."Channel" AS "Channel",
    "p"."Category" AS "Category",
    SUM("s"."Sales Amount") AS "revenue",
    COUNT(DISTINCT "so"."Sales Order") AS "orders",
    SUM("s"."Sales Amount" - "s"."Total Product Cost") AS "gross_profit"
  FROM "Sales" AS "s"
  JOIN "Sales_Order" AS "so"
    ON "s"."SalesOrderLineKey" = "so"."SalesOrderLineKey"
  JOIN "Product" AS "p"
    ON "s"."ProductKey" = "p"."ProductKey"
  GROUP BY
    "so"."Channel",
    "p"."Category"
),
"with_shares" AS (
  SELECT
    "Channel",
    "Category",
    "revenue",
    100.0 * "revenue" / SUM("revenue") OVER (PARTITION BY "Channel") AS "channel_revenue_share_pct",
    100.0 * SUM("revenue") OVER (
      PARTITION BY "Channel"
      ORDER BY "revenue" DESC, "Category" ASC
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) / SUM("revenue") OVER (PARTITION BY "Channel") AS "cumulative_channel_revenue_share_pct",
    "orders",
    "gross_profit"
  FROM "category_sales"
)
SELECT
  "Channel",
  "Category",
  "revenue",
  "channel_revenue_share_pct",
  "cumulative_channel_revenue_share_pct",
  "orders",
  "gross_profit"
FROM "with_shares"
ORDER BY
  "Channel" ASC,
  "revenue" DESC,
  "Category" ASC;
